pages.text: The skill tree system. Six trees, 40 levels each, 75 earnable points.$(br2)$(bold)Opening:$() Default key $(bold)K$(). The skill menu shows all six trees and your current point allocation.$(br2)$(bold)Point sources:$() Quest completion only. No XP-for-points — that's blocked by Pufferfish Unofficial Additions. Anti-farming by design.$(br2)$(bold)Respec:$() 5 XP levels per point refunded. A full respec of 75 points costs 375 levels — expensive but possible at endgame. Partial respecs (single tree) are more affordable.$(br2)$(bold)Engineering tree note:$() Engineering tree rewards are partially pending KubeJS implementation. See $(l:icraft:skills/tree_engineering)Engineering Tree$(/l) for details.
